messages:
maria.g: Quick follow-up from the postmortemwe shipped hotfixes for streaming timeouts but we still have follow-through items. I put together a short aftercare checklist, need clear owners + ETAs.
aj: Sounds good. Paste it here?
maria.g: Checklist: 1) bump client backoff defaults in SDK, 2) implement server-side graceful resume handshake, 3) add prefix-cache TTL auditing + logs, 4) create recurring regression job for partial responses, 5) close monitoring blindspots (heatmaps, traces).
cheng: I'll own (3) prefix-cache TTL audit. Can do EOW barring infra rate-limit approvals.
sophia: I'll own (4) regression job. Plan to reuse the eval harness and run randomized chunk/jitter runs. Target mid-next-week (Wed).
aj: I'll ship (1) today: PR for exponential backoff with jitter, release SDK tomorrow.
oncall-jordan: ops-bot showed a persistent tail in eu-west-1 around 03:00 UTC last week; suggest a regional heatmap and autoscale-correlation panel.
ops-bot: Alert: streaming-timeout-rate peaked at 4.2% on 2026-03-15T03:12:00Z (threshold 1.0%).
maria.g: On (2) resume handshake, proposal: server keeps KV cache for 3s after disconnect and accepts resume token for that window. Draft spec: https://confluence.internal/redwood/stream-resume-proposal (internal).
cheng: Hypothesis for stale prefix entries: some clients send truncated close frames -> kv entries persist. I'll add logging for session_close_reason and kv_ttl_hit and a metric `stream_prefix_kv_ttl_miss`. Query suggestion: `sum(rate(stream_session_close_total{reason!~"normal|client_closed"}[5m])) by (region)`
sophia: Regression job plan: scheduled CI job running harness with randomized chunk sizes and network jitter. If partial-response rate > 0.5% over 1h -> auto-create GH issue. Harness repo: gitlab.com/redwood/stream-harness (internal).
aj: SDK note: default backoff -> exponential starting 200ms to max 8s, with full jitter. Will add CHANGELOG and compatibility note.
maria.g: Ownership recap: (1) aj, (2) eng-runtime (sophia to coordinate), (3) cheng, (4) sophia, (5) oncall-jordan for monitoring & dashboards.
oncall-jordan: I'll add dashboard cards and a weekly digest for streaming-timeout-rate and partial responses, plus a slow-trace capture when reconnect latency > 2s.
aj: Release checklist: update CHANGELOG, bump SDK tag, push release, announce in #devex.
maria.g: Timelines: SDK bump by tomorrow, cache logs by EOW, regression job by next Wed, resume handshake spec review in 3 days, dashboards/digest by Friday. Flag slips here.
cheng: Creating ticket INFR-4127 prefix-cache: add TTL audit logs + metrics.
sophia: Opening STREAM-781 regression job + tests.
oncall-jordan: Creating DASH-129 heatmap + weekly digest.
maria.g: Can we do a 15-min sync tomorrow 09:30 PT to unblock any blockers? React with :thumbsup: if you can.
aj: :thumbsup:
cheng: :thumbsup:
sophia: :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Calendar: "Streaming aftercare sync" scheduled 2026-03-24T16:30Z (invite sent).
